catalog.description: Unidentified three-terminal part marked 4P. Numbered stock placeholder; pin functions unresolved.
5U: SD05 5V unidirectional TVS candidate; actual maker and board connections unconfirmed. Standard avalanche diode symbol.
5U: SD05 5V unidirectional TVS candidate; actual maker and board connections unconfirmed. Standard avalanche diode symbol.
G3: MMSZ5228BS 3.9V Zener candidate. PZU2.4B 2.4V alternative; exact fitted part unconfirmed.

notes.text: 01  POWER / INPUT FILTER
H01: likely S-1200B45 LDO. Nominal 4.5 V is a candidate, not a measured rail.
Original pad IDs on U1. Candidate datasheet pin numbers in parentheses.
Optional R1/R2/C3/C4 network: empty footprints; free ends unresolved.
02  PIC CONTROLLER / CLOCK / ICSP
H02: programming and decoupling inferred. Unassigned GPIOs stay open; PPS prevents a unique functional pin guess.
H03: R3/R4 divider candidate: 1/2 VBAT. Capacitor values estimated.
03  MOTOR / BUTTON / BATTERY INTERFACE
H04: MX512H typical supply/output topology. Motor A/B and MCU control assignments remain hypotheses.
C27 role unresolved
H05: NPN interface candidate; bias destination unresolved.
H06: S1 pairs and RC debounce inferred.
04  ANTENNA EXCITATION / LOGIC / INDICATOR
H07: U2 matches SN74LVC2G14 (C14R, 6 pins). Q8 probably contains two switching devices; exact type unresolved.
H09: B3 = RF output is low-confidence.
Q8 T2/B1/B2 power assignments open.
05  RF RECEIVE / GAIN / ENVELOPE
H10-H12: working topology around photographed 120k feedback resistors. Filters, bias, and interstage routes inferred.
C42 / R47 / R46: DNP options, exact pads unresolved.
06  SWITCHED ANTENNA CAPACITANCE
H13: 2H devices are probably PNP BJTs (MMBTA55 family; PBSS5140T is an alternative). Capacitor values unknown.
Selected working hypothesis: Ctop in series with (Cfront || Crear). Rear-bank vias suggest paired lower capacitors.
Ceff = Ctop * (Cfront + Crear) / (Ctop + Cfront + Crear). Equal values give 2C/3 per enabled branch.
All-parallel and all-series banks remain alternatives. Emitter rail / collector orientation is provisional.
07  PIR / AUXILIARY RAIL
H14-H15: J3 pin order and U6 LDO topology are low-confidence.
08  UNRESOLVED / UNPOPULATED OPTIONS
No invented ties on untraced spare pads; original reference aliases retained.
READING THIS WORKING RECONSTRUCTION
One sheet. Functional wiring is proposed; this is not a verified production circuit.
150 original main-board catalog entries, including DNP footprints and named pads.
H_* = inferred inter-block net. Other net names do not imply measurement.
? on a part value or pin function means an estimate or candidate identity.
Original photographed pad names remain on ambiguous packages (L/R/S etc.).
U2 and U3 use multiple symbol units on this same sheet, including supply units.
29 original local visual fragments are retained; added connections are hypotheses.
PIC GPIOs are intentionally unassigned where photographs cannot support a map.
DNP = unpopulated. An open pin means unresolved, not a certified no-connect.
PIR daughterboard internals are not yet traced; J3 represents its interface.
No capacitor value or rail voltage in this drawing was electrically measured.
See docs/RECONSTRUCTION.md for evidence, alternatives, and calculations.
Spare footprints / unassigned test pads
